title: May downloaded search packages run their own setup programs?
context: When local search is first turned on, the packages it downloads can run their own setup programs on the user's machine. At least one does: onnxruntime-node 1.30.0 runs node ./script/install after it installs. Those programs are code the directory reviewer never read. Allowing them is what happens today and adds a README sentence beside your fixed one. Either of the other two changes the exact install command in AC-3, adds work, and needs a test that local search still works, since stopping them may break it.
